summary: Fixed Gitea automatic sign-in so signing out of MyPortal (or losing the Script editing permission) signs a technician out of Gitea. Gitea keeps its own persistent session, so the reverse proxy now strips the browser's cookies from Gitea requests whenever MyPortal forwards no identity, preventing a stale Gitea session from keeping a technician signed in; signed-in requests keep their cookies so Gitea's CSRF protection still works. Applied to both the blue/green and Docker nginx configs, added a regression test, and corrected the gitea_sign_in docstring that wrongly claimed Gitea keeps no session of its own.
